environment.description: Same EC2 instance (m5.large) in us-east-1 VPC. pgBouncer in transaction pooling mode with prepared statements. Instance metadata service configured with HttpTokens=required (IMDSv2 enforcement) AND HttpPutResponseHopLimit=1. Application runs inside a network namespace created via systemd's PrivateNetwork=no with RestrictAddressFamily=AF_INET AF_INET6, combined with a per-unit nftables ruleset loaded via ExecStartPre that drops all packets with destination in 169.254.0.0/16 originating from the application's cgroup (nft add rule inet filter output meta cgroup $APP_CGROUP ip daddr 169.254.0.0/16 drop). The instance's IAM role has a permission boundary that denies sts:* actions. pgBouncer connection uses prepared statement protocol-level parameterization preventing SQL injection in the stored queries.

config.systemd_unit_nftables: nft add rule inet filter output meta cgroup $APP_CGROUP ip daddr 169.254.0.0/16 drop
